Great - Wednesday 3/25 10:30 PT works for me. I'll bring a short deck and the sensitivity slices you asked for. Quick answers up front so your finance team has context before the meeting:

1) Token-breakdown scenarios (examples in the attached sheet)
- Low case (800 tokens): 300 prompt / 500 response
- Base case (1,200 tokens): 400 prompt / 800 response
- High case (2,000 tokens): 600 prompt / 1,400 response

2) Per-feature cost calculation (formula and examples)
- Formula: cost_per_feature = (avg_tokens_per_call / 1,000,000) * price_per_1M_tokens
- Examples at 1,200 tokens:
  - $15 / 1M => (1,200 / 1,000,000) * $15 = $0.018 per feature
  - $20 / 1M => (1,200 / 1,000,000) * $20 = $0.024 per feature
  - $25 / 1M => (1,200 / 1,000,000) * $25 = $0.030 per feature

3) CAC payback sensitivity (summary)
Assumptions (examples):
- ARPU from LLM-driven feature = $2.00 / active user / month
- Avg feature usage = 5 calls / user / month => revenue per feature-user = $0.40 / month
- If inference cost (at $20 / 1M, 1,200 tokens) => cost_per_feature = $0.024 => monthly inference cost per user = 5 * $0.024 = $0.12
- Gross margin contribution per user = $0.40 - $0.12 = $0.28 / month
- With LTV 12mo = $48, target payback <= 6mo implies allowable CAC <= 6 * $0.28 = $1.68 per acquired user under these assumptions

If inference cost rises to $25 / 1M, cost_per_feature becomes $0.030 and margin shrinks; allowable CAC (6mo payback) drops to ~ $1.20 in the same example. The spreadsheet attached includes a table showing CAC allowances across different price points and usage intensities so you can plug in your LTV assumptions.

4) Deliverables before the call
- I'll upload a version of the model with the three token scenarios and a tab that calculates CAC payback for your LTV inputs.
- I'll also add a short one-page summary (PDF) with the pricing bands we can offer at 12/24/36 mo commitments.

If legal wants an initial pricing schedule ahead of the call, say the word and I'll share a draft.

See you Wed - I’ll send a calendar invite with a dial-in.

Best,
